rows.coder_note: Reference 6 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6) has four dictionary rows. The sentences that carry it give 2,923 proteins on Olink Explore in 54,219 UK Biobank participants (p005) and 45,397 participants (p072); neither N is that of any row, and neither sentence holds an attribute that separates the rows. 'European ancestry' is stated only in p006, a passage with no link to reference 6, about the summary statistics of all three pQTL studies together, so rule E is not met.
